title: Coding Set 01: Sliding Window & Stack Balancing
description: Two classic HCL reported string problems: minimum window covering all distinct characters and parenthesis validation with removal count.

problems.title: Smallest Substring Containing All Distinct Characters
problems.statement: Given a string S consisting of lowercase/uppercase ASCII letters, find the length of the smallest contiguous substring of S that contains every distinct character present in S at least once. If S is empty, print 0.
problems.inputFormat: A single line containing string S.
problems.outputFormat: A single integer denoting the minimum window length.
constraints: S contains printable non-whitespace ASCII characters
Target complexity: O(|S|) time, O(1) alphabet space

problems.timeComplexity: O(N) — each pointer (`left`, `right`) visits each character at most once.
problems.spaceComplexity: O(K) where K <= 256 is the number of distinct ASCII characters.

problems.title: Valid Parentheses & Minimum Bracket Removals
problems.statement: Given a string containing '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', and ']', determine if it is strictly balanced.
